# v2.41-dev Release Notes

## Partner-program roster fix + consistent pagination

Two fixes in this release: the partner-program "View" list now matches the number
it's shown next to, and the paginated report tables now use the same pager style as
the rest of the app.

### Fixed

- **Partner program "View" now lists everyone who was counted.** On a program
  dashboard, a requirement could show e.g. **2 people** as attained, but clicking
  **View** listed only **1**. The attained count credits anyone holding *any*
  catalogue variant of the required training **or** any of its listed
  alternatives — but the View drill-down was only looking up the exact primary and
  alternative titles, so anyone who qualified via a differently-named variant of
  the same training was counted yet missing from the list. The View roster now
  expands to the same set of training variants the count uses, so the number and
  the list always agree (for both the primary training and every "or …"
  alternative).

### Changed

- **One consistent pagination style everywhere.** The **Currently Expired** and
  **Learner Achievement Scorecard** report tables previously used a different pager
  ("Prev / Page X of Y / Next" with an "N / page" selector) than the rest of the
  app. They now use the same control as the Students list and every other table:
  a **Show [N] records** selector with **Showing X to Y of N** and numbered page
  buttons. Paging behaviour is unchanged — these two tables still page on the
  server, and exports still contain the full filtered set, not just the visible
  page.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- The pager is now a single shared component, so the two surfaces can't drift
  apart in future.
